item.tib: sde brgyad drag po'i gtor bzlog
item.coloph: 'di ni slob dpon gsang bas mdzad do/ de nas dbal gshen stag las mdzad do/ des na zhang zhung hris pa gyer med dang / rgyung yar bla chen khod spungs dang / stang chen dmu tsha gyer med gsum gyis mdzad do/ sde brgyad gzungs ring gyi gtor bzlog dbal gtor gsang ba'i b+hen zlog du bya ba/ bzlog pa thun zlog du bya ba/ gtor bzlog chung ba 'ben zlog bya ba/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi gtor zlog rdzogs sA+o// zhang zhung hris pa gyer med kyis phyi rabs don du bris pa'o/ mang mkhar lcags 'phrang la gtad/ las 'phro can dang spyod par shog 'di la shog ser dmar skya kha dras cig la/ yig 'phreng bcu bzhi bcu gsum 'dug pa'i bu la bris gtug legs par byas/ bla ma dpon gsas khyung rgod rtsal gyis mang mkhar lcags 'phrang nas bton pa lags so//
